KEEPING YOU IN THE AIR
Integrated aviation solutions from nose to tail
From maintenance and materials to sales and modifications, AerSale simplifies the complex—delivering complete support across the full aircraft lifecycle to save time and reduce costs.
See in-stock aircraft, engines, landing gear, and APUs—ready to go.
No middlemen. No needless markups. Just complete, connected service that keeps your fleet in the air.

From component and airframe MRO to inventory, sales, asset management, and teardowns, AerSale connects every service you need—without the extra costs and headaches that come with managing multiple vendors. Our divisions work as one, eliminating inefficiencies, reducing turnaround times, and keeping your aftermarket strategy profitable, predictable, and ready for takeoff.

From taxi to touchdown, AerAware delivers gate-to-gate visibility to support safer, more confident operations.
AerSafe®: Fuel Tank Safety, Simplified
Efficient, reliable, and fast to install, AerSafe meets mandates without long OEM lead times or costly modifications.
AerTrak®: Flexible ADS-B Out Alternative
FAA-certified and cost-effective, AerTrak minimizes downtime and works with most avionics for seamless ADS-B Out compliance.

pages.raw_meta: Led by respected industry professionals, AerSale is involved in nearly every aspect of the aviation aftermarket.
raw_blocks: Experts in aircraft, engines, components, and OEM alternatives
Everything you need. One integrated company.
We provide customers with complete lifecycle management to ensure reliability, drive efficiency, and create value.

In 2008, Nicolas Finazzo and Robert Nichols recognized an opportunity to provide premier mid-life aircraft and flight equipment support and founded AerSale. They hired a small staff of employees and began what would become a great acquisition of aircraft, engines, other companies, and facilities. Customers came—and stayed. Today, the AerSale family includes over 600 employees at 11 locations in four countries and continues to grow.
See who we are and what we do—in less than 2 minutes.

AerSale upholds the highest safety and compliance standards across its global network. With strategically positioned facilities, we deliver trusted solutions and seamless support—wherever our customers operate.
Watch your career take off with us. See open jobs and join our talent network.
